name: giga-stream-fileserver
description: The Giga Stream fileserver (docs/03 Part A) and, in desktop mode, its Electron host (src/app). Owns the local node:sqlite database (settings, shell state, collections, favorites, watch history, local files, jobs), reads the admin backend's channels, titles and providers on demand, streams scan progress as NDJSON, and serves the interface same-origin. REST only: no WebSocket anywhere (docs/01 section 4.4).
